name: Navalperal de Tormes (Spain)
description: Square white flag with a compony border of blue and white pieces, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Navalperal de Tormes (a pear tree above waves and a chequy field).
history: The arms and the flag were approved on 29 March 2001 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 127 of 2 July 2001); the flag is a square cloth of 1:1, white with a border composed of blue and white pieces and the municipal arms at the centre.
